verdict.rationale: Paddle's MCP server exposes an 'execute' tool that can 'chain one or more Paddle API calls in a single invocation,' letting an AI agent script pseudo-bulk workflows (e.g., looping updates across many subscriptions/customers) rather than requiring one-off manual calls. However, there is no evidence of native bulk/batch REST endpoints (e.g., bulk create/update transactions or subscriptions) or documented rate-limit-aware batch processing guidance. Missing for 10: dedicated bulk/batch API endpoints, documented pagination-aware bulk workflows, and independent evidence of successful large-scale batch operations via the MCP execute tool.
